selectionRule: Active and unreviewed after Tranches 1-13, ordered dependency-first: every prerequisite definition available in the pool is selected before any filler, by fan-out then candidate id. Legacy rank is not used: the mythology migration left it non-contiguous.
shortfallNote: A shortfall is a property target the remaining inventory cannot meet. It is recorded rather than absorbed, so a later tranche is not misread as having under-selected a property that had nothing left to give.
